Government Proposes New Shelf-Life Rules for Imported Drugs

The Indian government has proposed a draft amendment to drug import rules, suggesting a minimum residual shelf life of 12 months for imported medicines. This move aims to streamline the import process, potentially easing regulations for research and development purposes. The proposal is open for public comment.
